summary: A Yes vote increases Solano County's transient occupancy tax on overnight lodging in unincorporated areas from 5% to 12% of the total rent charged.

tax.text: A Yes vote would increase the county transient occupancy tax from 5% to 12% for hotels and other temporary lodging facilities in unincorporated areas.
tax.quote: Measure H would increase Solano County’s transient occupancy tax from a rate of 5% to 12% of rents charged at hotels and other temporary lodging facilities in unincorporated areas of the county.

tax.text: A No vote would keep the county transient occupancy tax at 5% in those areas.
tax.quote: Measure H would increase Solano County’s transient occupancy tax from a rate of 5% to 12% of rents charged at hotels and other temporary lodging facilities in unincorporated areas of the county.
